# Pesher Habakkuk Column 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 10 | **Condition:** Some damage; partially reconstructed

---

**10:1** "Will-not your-creditors suddenly arise

**10:2** and-those-who-make-you-tremble awake?

**10:3** You-will-become their-spoil.

**10:4** Because you-have-plundered many nations,

**10:5** all the-remnant-of the-peoples shall-plunder you" (Hab 2:7-8a).

**10:6** Its pesher concerns the-priest who-rebelled

**10:7** [...] the-statutes-of [God...]

**10:8** and-they abused-him with-the-vengeance-of wicked-

**10:9** [ness,] and-inflicted on-him horrible diseases

**10:10** and-acts-of-revenge on-his-body-of-flesh.

**10:11** "Because-of the-blood-of men and-the-violence-done-to the-land,

**10:12** the-city, and-all who-dwell in-it" (Hab 2:8b).

**10:13** Its pesher concerns the-Wicked-Priest whom,

**10:14** because-of the-wrong-done to the-Teacher-of-Righteousness

**10:15** and-the-men-of his-council, God delivered

**10:16** into-the-hand-of his-enemies to-afflict-him

**10:17** with-a-destroying-blow in-bitterness-of-soul, because he-had-done-wickedly against His-chosen-ones.

---
*EMET notes: Column 10 covers Hab 2:7-8. The pesher format alternates between quotations of Habakkuk and their sectarian interpretations (pesharim). Hyphenated forms reflect Hebrew construct chains and bound morphemes. Technical sectarian terms preserved: Teacher of Righteousness (Moreh ha-Tsedeq), Wicked Priest (ha-Kohen ha-Rasha'), Man of the Lie (Ish ha-Kazav), Kittim (identified with Romans), Spouter of the Lie (Mattif ha-Kazav). Lacunae marked with [...] represent genuine manuscript damage.*
